description: Configure an animated overlay. It starts from the overlay's default, or from the published example you name, then applies your values, look, aspect, duration or background. Returns its configuration URL, free/Pro tier, relevance (field ids the final configuration uses or does not), activeCues (taps this exact configuration has, usable as sfx overlay-cue ids; empty when it has none) and inactiveEdits (requested values kept but unused by this configuration, with a notice). Field errors list allowed inputs so you can correct and retry; a value the overlay fixes is always an error, so choose another overlay for a different design. Only the unchanged default of a free overlay is free: another example, look, text or setting generally needs Pro to render, while aspect and background stay free.

example.description: A published example id from get_overlay. Omit for the default.

overlay.description: An overlay id returned by list_overlays.

name: configure_overlay
